install_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

echo "==> Installing LibreOffice (Writer, Calc, Impress, Draw, Base)"

# Prefer distro archives only — ignore broken third-party repos (exit 100).
apt_update_safe() {
  local opts=(-o APT::Get::List-Cleanup=0)
  if [[ -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources ]]; then
    apt-get update "${opts[@]}" \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- && return 0
  fi
  if [[ -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources ]]; then
    apt-get update "${opts[@]}" \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list.d/debian.sources \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- && return 0
  fi
  if [[ -f /etc/apt/sources.list ]]; then
    apt-get update "${opts[@]}" \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- && return 0
  fi
  apt-get update -y || true
}
apt_update_safe

# Metapackage pulls Writer/Calc/Impress/Draw/Base; GTK3 helps desktop/VNC UI;
# Liberation fonts improve MS Office document compatibility.
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  libreoffice \
  libreoffice-gtk3 \
  fonts-liberation \
  fonts-dejavu-core

echo "==> Verifying"
command -v libreoffice
libreoffice --version || true
echo "==> LibreOffice installed"
uninstall_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

echo "==> Fully removing LibreOffice"
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apt-get remove -y --purge \
    'libreoffice*' \
    fonts-liberation \
    fonts-dejavu-core || true
  apt-get autoremove -y || true
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf remove -y libreoffice || true
elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pacman -Rns --noconfirm libreoffice-fresh || true
fi
echo "==> LibreOffice removed"
upgrade_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

echo "==> Upgrading LibreOffice"
apt_update_safe() {
  local opts=(-o APT::Get::List-Cleanup=0)
  if [[ -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources ]]; then
    apt-get update "${opts[@]}" \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- && return 0
  fi
  if [[ -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources ]]; then
    apt-get update "${opts[@]}" \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list.d/debian.sources \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- && return 0
  fi
  if [[ -f /etc/apt/sources.list ]]; then
    apt-get update "${opts[@]}" \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- && return 0
  fi
  apt-get update -y || true
}
apt_update_safe
apt-get install -y --only-upgrade --no-install-recommends \
  libreoffice \
  libreoffice-gtk3 \
  fonts-liberation \
  fonts-dejavu-core || apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  libreoffice libreoffice-gtk3 fonts-liberation fonts-dejavu-core
libreoffice --version || true
echo "==> LibreOffice upgraded"
